# Lumen 1.3.3
Added **Device Folders** and **Album Sync** for existing photos (big thanks to @KMohZaid for suggesting both in #15 and #16), finished extracting the leftover English strings for translators, and went through a full bug-fix and security audit pass. Most of the internal changes won't show up on screen, just closing edge cases around share intents, background folder scans, account cleanup, and log exports.
---
### New Features & UI
- **Device Folders** *(suggested by @KMohZaid in #16)*: Added a browser for media folders already on your phone so you don't have to pick directories manually one by one. You can check photo/video counts with thumbnails, sort by recent or most items, assign an **Account** and **Album**, and flip **Auto-backup** on right from the list.
- **Sync Existing Photos to Albums** *(suggested by @KMohZaid in #15)*: Photos that are already uploaded to Google Photos can now be matched and added to their folder's assigned **Album** instead of getting skipped by deduplication. You can run it on demand or let **Auto-sync** handle it.
- **Folders & Settings Polish**: Moved the multi-account avatar badge onto the folder icon in **Folders** so assigning an **Album** doesn't push it out of place. Whole rows now toggle switches in **Settings**, **Accent Palette** chips fit without weird vertical gaps, and **Account Safety** plus **Find Album Link** dialogs match the rest of the Material 3 Expressive styling.
- **Account Card Swipe Nudge**: Fixed the swipe hint animation on **Backup** (it was cancelling itself before sliding), dropped the extra **Switch** button once an **Account** is connected, and added a replay option in **Settings** and **Mock Mode** if you want to see the gesture again.
---
### Bug Fixes & Improvements
- **Share Confirmation & Staging Limits**: Sending a second share intent while **Manual Upload** is already open no longer replaces your pending **Upload** batch silently—you now see file name previews and get a Switch/Ignore banner instead. Share batches also cap at 100 items, staging streams have disk size limits, and failed or cancelled temp copies clean up right away instead of sitting in cache.
- **Delete After Backup Scope**: **Delete device copy after backup** now only deletes files belonging to enabled **Folders**. Sharing or picking files through **Manual Upload** won't trigger original file deletion anymore.
- **Volume & Symlink Checks**: Background MediaStore scans now check storage volume IDs and skip symlinks, so an SD card or USB drive with a `DCIM/Camera` folder doesn't accidentally match your internal **Folders**.
- **Account Removal Cleanup**: Removing an **Account** now clears its hash cache rows, **Folders**, **Albums**, watermarks, and custom avatar from disk instead of leaving stale entries behind for other accounts to see.
- **Background & Mock Mode Fixes**: **Mock Mode** won't overwrite real unassigned folders with mock emails anymore, avatar uploads have a 10 MB stream cap, and `BootReceiver`, WorkManager, and foreground service handoffs were cleaned up.
---
### Internationalization & Translations
- **Remaining String Extraction**: Pulled the last hardcoded English strings out of **Add Folder**, **Device Folders**, **Onboarding**, **Folders**, **Albums**, **Accounts**, **Settings**, and the OEM background guides. English and Indonesian are synced at 558 keys.
---
### Security Hardening
- **Shared Report Redaction**: **Hide file names in shared report** actually strips file paths (including paths with spaces), file names, and album names from real `WARN`/`ERROR` logs and crash traces now instead of only masking mock log entries. Copied logs are also flagged as sensitive on Android 13+.
- **Auth, Updates & Intents**: Restricted imported credential keys to an allowlist, locked the Google sign-in WebView down to `google.com`, turned off automatic HTTP redirects, clamped `Retry-After` headers, added APK SHA-256 verification and size caps to the updater, gated OEM auto-start intents to system apps, and added an internal token check on update notification intents.
